incidentDetail.record.title: Record
incidentDetail.sev.s1.label: Level 1 (S1)
incidentDetail.sev.s2.label: Level 2 (S2)
incidentDetail.sev.s3.label: Level 3 (S3)
incidentDetail.sev.s1.def: Impacts company or customer sensitive information; impacts systems, networks or users in other OpCos; impacts local critical systems or core network; disrupts a critical internal or OS process; likely to reach media and affect Group reputation.
incidentDetail.sev.s2.def: Impacts company or customer non-sensitive information; impacts non-critical local or customer systems and access-layer networks; affects a non-critical local or OS business process.
incidentDetail.sev.s3.def: No impact on company or customer information; impacts a non-critical local system without business interruption; indicates a potential threat of imminent attack.
incidentDetail.notify.title: Notification log
incidentDetail.rca.title: Root cause analysis
incidentDetail.rca.causeS3: Not mandatory for Level 3 — recorded for trend analysis only.
incidentDetail.rca.cause: Process control was bypassed: the mandatory verification step in the workflow could be skipped without a system block, and monitoring did not alert on the exception.
incidentDetail.work.title: Workaround
incidentDetail.work.plan: Isolate the affected asset, revoke the exposed access path, and switch the affected process to the manual verified route until the permanent fix is deployed.
incidentDetail.corr.title: Corrective action
incidentDetail.corr.plan: Enforce the missing verification as a system gate, and re-run the control test on a full sample of the last 30 days of transactions.
incidentDetail.prev.title: Preventive action
incidentDetail.prev.plan: Add the failure mode to the Risk Management Report worksheet, extend awareness training to the affected business unit, and add a monthly exception report to the Security Metric Program.
incidentDetail.approval.title: Review & approval
incidentDetail.approval.reviewed: Reviewed on behalf of the CISO
incidentDetail.approval.note: The incident record is retained with the ISMS evidence set. Closure requires the root cause, corrective and preventive action sections to be complete for Level 1 and Level 2 incidents.
